label: HOME at 390px (dark mode)
verdict:
VERDICT: PASS

BRAND-COLOR: Partially — bright aqua/teal accents and white/cream cards are clearly present, but the background reads dark charcoal, not warm cream (dark mode makes this defensible).

PHOTOGRAPHY: Yes — real doctor portraits (Rajesh, second card) and photos render crisply with proper rounding.

LIFE-DELIGHT: Yes — cream stats billboard, pulsing "live" chip, photos, and a floating glass nav pill make the screen feel alive compared to the original.

LAYOUT: Bottom is compromised — the nav pill overlaps and clips the "Lab tests at home / Book in 3 taps" row, and the acid/chip row ("acidity") plus peeking hospital cards feel tightly cropped at 390px.

NAV-PILL: Present with readable Home/Bookings/Profile labels and a clear active Home tab (white icon + label vs. dimmed others).

FLIP-STATE: Two of three flip — "image-less" and "lifeless" are decisively overturned; "colorless" is only half-flipped since the cream canvas is absent in dark mode.

NITPICKS:
1. Major — floating nav pill overlaps/cuts off the "Lab tests at home" promo row at the bottom; add bottom padding so content clears the pill.
2. Minor — warm cream background not present (dark surface instead); consider cream-tinted dark cards or reserving cream for the stats billboard (already done) more broadly.
3. Minor — "acidity" quick-filter chip is clipped mid-word at the right edge; ensure a visible affordance (partial card peek is fine, half-cut text is not).
